title: "settings" icon in the right corner of a panel is now pointless and can be removed
line: In edit mode, panels no longer show the redundant settings button at their end, so widgets can use that space.
explanation: Since edit mode lets you click anywhere on a panel to open its settings, the panel toolbox (the settings button at the end of the panel) only duplicated that, took space from the widgets and sat in the way while resizing them. David Edmundson's draft MR plasma-desktop!2206 removes it but no longer applies on master. This ports it: the paneltoolbox package and its install are removed, the panel containment drops all toolbox sizing and margins, and the shell's defaults no longer ask for org.kde.paneltoolbox (the MR missed that line).

commits.message:
containments/panel: drop the panel toolbox

In edit mode the whole panel can already be clicked to open its settings,
so the settings button at the end of the panel only duplicated that while
taking space from the widgets. Remove the toolbox and its layout handling.

BUG: 487687
